cross_package_notes.note: Verified postMessage origin enforcement in EmbedPage.vue: inbound GENYEE:context messages require isOriginAllowed(event.origin, config.value?.allowed_origins ?? []) over explicit http(s) origins, and outbound GENYEE:ready / GENYEE:close / GENYEE:resize messages resolve targetOrigin via resolveParentOrigin (refusing '*' fallback whenever allowed_origins is configured and never transmitting session or embed tokens).

Verified artifact preview isolation boundary across Slice 3 views and Slice 2 shared components: ChatArtifactsDrawer and ArtifactLibrary delegate HTML/SVG/Markdown artifact rendering exclusively to shared ArtifactPreview components (owned by w6-fe-components-hooks) while enforcing sequence-fenced listMessageArtifacts loads, workspace/user switch resets, and URL-encoded session navigation at the view layer.

Verified zero external QR/CDN requests and zero legacy brand residues across all 218 files in the 8 owned view units; embed snippet generation and QR rendering live in shared frontend/src/components/ modules (owned by w6-fe-components-hooks).

invariants_checked: AgentList enforces active-workspace ownership (effectiveTenantId) in canManageAgent and routes cross-tenant shared deep-links (?edit=<id>) to read-only inspection instead of mutable editor state.
AgentList sequences spaceSelection and fetchList requests so out-of-order responses from earlier workspace filters cannot overwrite active agent cards.

AgentEditorModal hides share management and dirty-form snapshots in readOnly mode, renders prompt placeholder chips via text bindings instead of v-html, and clears catalog/highlight/popup timers on unmount.

findings.summary: canManageAgent granted hasRole('admin') without verifying the agent belonged to the active workspace, checkAndOpenEditModal opened mutable AgentEditorModal on cross-tenant shared deep-links, and spaceSelection/fetchList lacked sequence fencing.
findings.regression_test: AgentList denies canManageAgent on cross-tenant shared agents and routes shared deep-links to read-only detail, AgentList ignores out-of-order spaceSelection and fetchList responses

findings.summary: Read-only agent inspection exposed the share management tab and dirty formData snapshot, rendered six placeholder token chips via v-html instead of v-text, and left catalogPollTimer/highlight/popup timers active on unmount.
findings.regression_test: AgentEditorModal hides share management and dirty snapshot in readOnly mode, escapes placeholder tokens without v-html, and clears timers on unmount

invariants_checked: ArtifactLibrary encodes session_id path segments with encodeURIComponent before router navigation and closes/reloads artifact state whenever active workspace (effectiveTenantId) or authenticated user changes.
Artifact preview drawer delegates rendering to sandboxed ArtifactPreview components without direct v-html or unsanitized blob execution.

findings.summary: openSession interpolated item.session_id into /platform/chat/${session_id} without encodeURIComponent, and SPA workspace/user switches left stale artifact rows and preview drawers mounted.
findings.regression_test: ArtifactLibrary URL-encodes session_id in openSession and reloads on workspace or user switch

invariants_checked: AutomationDetail fences loadDetail, loadRuns, loadGrants, runNow, toggle, and cancel with detailVersion so late responses after switching automations or closing the drawer cannot mutate active state.
AutomationEditor declares trigger preview state prior to immediate visibility watchers and cancels debounced validateTrigger timers on close and unmount.

findings.summary: loadGrants, runNow, toggle, and cancel lacked detailVersion fencing, allowing late responses from a previously viewed automation to overwrite grants and run history on the newly selected automation.
findings.regression_test: AutomationDetail drops stale loadGrants, runNow, and cancel responses after switching or closing

findings.summary: Immediate props.visible watcher referenced previewRuns/previewError before initialization (TDZ ReferenceError when mounted visible) and left debounced previewTimer pending across close/unmount.
findings.regression_test: AutomationEditor clears debounced trigger validation timer on unmount

invariants_checked: All citation popovers, web search/fetch cards, document links, and MCP OAuth popups enforce strict http(s): protocol validation and rel="noopener noreferrer" (severing popup.opener), blocking javascript:/data: XSS.

Markdown and knowledge chunk summaries pass through DOMPurify-backed sanitizeHTML / renderMarkdownHtml before v-html binding, and declarative capture click handlers preserve image lightbox behavior across v-if transitions.

HITL approval cards (ToolApprovalCard, HostApprovalCard, AskUserCard, SecureFormCard, PendingPromptDock) reject held-Enter key-repeat auto-submission, prevent duplicate inline submissions, require empty serviceId before displaying built-in GENYEE operation labels, and resume suspended runs on server resolution.

Session streaming, follow-up suggestion polling, steer continue-stream attachment, suspended-run resume, wiki preview drawers, and artifact drawers fence async callbacks on session/version epochs and clean up timers on route leave and unmount.

findings.summary: handleCitationActivate read untrusted data-url attributes from .citation-web nodes without protocol validation and passed them to BrowserOpenURL, window.open, and window.location.assign (javascript:/data: execution), while openWikiDrawer lacked sequence and unmount guards.
findings.regression_test: AgentStreamDisplay blocks javascript/data URLs in handleCitationActivate and guards openWikiDrawer against stale responses and unmount

findings.summary: docInfo, WebFetchResults, and WebSearchResults bound untrusted external URLs directly to anchor href attributes without http(s): validation, and KnowledgeChunksList rendered summaryHtml via v-html without sanitizeHTML.
findings.regression_test: docInfo, WebFetchResults, WebSearchResults, and KnowledgeChunksList block unsafe href protocols and sanitize chunk summary HTML

findings.summary: McpOAuthCard opened upstream authorizationUrl without http(s): validation, left popup.opener intact on untrusted OAuth windows, lacked overlap/unmount guards on /oauth/status polling, and disabled Skip while authorizing.
findings.regression_test: McpOAuthCard validates http(s) popup URL, severs opener, guards poll overlap/unmount, and keeps Skip enabled while authorizing

findings.summary: Held-down Enter key auto-repeat approved consecutive queued HITL prompts without review, and ToolApprovalCard checked serviceName === 'GENYEE' without requiring empty serviceId, letting an external MCP server named GENYEE spoof built-in operation prompts.
findings.regression_test: PendingPromptDock ignores held-Enter auto-repeat and ToolApprovalCard requires empty serviceId for GENYEE operation display

findings.summary: HostApprovalCard did not record/check promptSubmission state (permitting duplicate inline approval submissions before SSE resolution) and ignored { resumed } responses instead of invoking resumeSuspendedRun.
findings.regression_test: HostApprovalCard records submission to prevent double-submit and resumes suspended runs when server reports resumed

findings.summary: loadFollowUpSuggestions, attachSteerFollowUp, and resumeSuspendedRun ignored chatLoadVersion increments on route leave/unmount (leaking background polling and continue-stream attachments), and clearData/onUnmounted did not clear suggestedDebounceTimer.
findings.regression_test: chat index cancels loadFollowUpSuggestions, attachSteerFollowUp, and resumeSuspendedRun loops when chatLoadVersion advances on leave/unmount

findings.summary: ChatArtifactsDrawer lacked sequence fencing and [sessionId, messageId] reload watches on listMessageArtifacts, while botmsg attached handleMarkdownImageClick imperatively once in onMounted on a v-if-toggled parentMd container.
findings.regression_test: ChatArtifactsDrawer guards listMessageArtifacts against out-of-order loads and botmsg binds capture click handler declaratively on parentMd

invariants_checked: creatChat clears debounced suggested-question timers on unmount and URL-encodes newly created session IDs before navigating to /platform/chat/:sessionId.

findings.summary: debounceTimer for fetchSuggestedQuestions was not cleared on unmount, and navigateToSession interpolated sessionId into /platform/chat/${sessionId} without encodeURIComponent.
findings.regression_test: creatChat clears debounced suggested-question timer on unmount and URL-encodes sessionId on navigation

invariants_checked: EmbedPage validates inbound postMessage origins against config.allowed_origins, refuses '*' fallback on outbound parent postMessage when allowed_origins is non-empty, and strips CSS injection tokens from untrusted primary_color.
EmbedBotMessage enforces http(s): validation on web citation popover links and renders markdown via sanitized renderMarkdownHtml.
EmbedChatCore cancels 120s follow-up suggestion polling and ignores stale starter suggestion responses when unmounted or re-keyed across embed session resets.

findings.summary: Web citation popover bound citationFloat.url extracted from .citation-web[data-url] directly to <a :href> without http(s): protocol validation, permitting javascript:/data: XSS on click.
findings.regression_test: EmbedBotMessage blocks unsafe javascript/data schemes in web citation popover href

findings.summary: Unmounting EmbedChatCore on session reset leaked 120s loadFollowUpSuggestions polling and stale fetchSuggestedQuestions writes, and EmbedPage interpolated config.primary_color into CSS custom properties without stripping CSS injection tokens.
findings.regression_test: EmbedChatCore stops follow-up suggestion polling and ignores stale starter suggestions after unmount, EmbedPage strips CSS injection tokens from untrusted primary_color

invariants_checked: KnowledgeBase, FAQEntryManager, WikiBrowser, WikiRevisionDrawer, DataSourceSettings, DataSourceEditorDialog, DataSourceSyncLogs, KnowledgeBaseActivitySettings, KBShareSettings, KBChunkingDebug, KnowledgeBaseList, UploadConfirmDialog, ImageGallery, and GallerySourcePicker isolate polling timers, debounce timers, unsaved temp data sources, and in-flight async responses across KB switches and component unmount.

Shared-KB and active-workspace RBAC guards (FAQEntryManager canEdit/canManage, KnowledgeBaseEditorModal canShareKB/canViewActivity, WikiBrowser canEdit folder/drag/issue controls) honor effectiveTenantId, CreatorRoleFloor ('contributor'), and organization share permissions so read-only viewers never see write/share controls.

External URL openings (FAQEntryManager failed_entries_url, KbUploadSourceDropdown URL submission) enforce http(s): schemes and noopener,noreferrer, and WikiBrowser escapes [[slug|display]] and index metadata outside code spans prior to DOMPurify sanitization.

findings.summary: downloadFailedEntries opened failed_entries_url without http(s): validation or noopener,noreferrer; canEdit/canManage ignored my_permission/getKBPermission (exposing edit/manage UI on read-only shared FAQ KBs to local admins) while gating single-entry edit/delete on canManage; and FAQ import polling leaked across kbId switches and unmount.
findings.regression_test: FAQEntryManager blocks unsafe failed_entries_url schemes, aligns shared-KB RBAC, and isolates import polling across KB switches and unmount

findings.summary: fetchWikiStatusOnce could resurrect 5s wikiStatusTimer after unmount or overwrite another KB on late getWikiStats resolution, and switching kbId left drawer, batch selection, move polling, autoOpenRequest, and search debounce state active.
findings.regression_test: KnowledgeBase prevents wiki status polling resurrection after unmount and resets drawer/move/batch/debounce state on KB switch

findings.summary: canShareKB omitted active effectiveTenantId and contributor role floor checks, canViewActivity compared against home currentTenantId instead of effectiveTenantId, handleGenerateProfile/loadImageAttrSchema lacked generation guards, and resetState left generatedProfile/dsCount stale.
findings.regression_test: KnowledgeBaseEditorModal enforces active effectiveTenantId and contributor floor on share/activity gates and guards async profile/schema loads

findings.summary: Read-only viewers saw folder actions, drag-and-drop, and Global Issues write buttons despite !props.canEdit; renderMarkdown expanded [[slug|display]] inside code spans without escaping quotes/angle brackets (and appendIndexDirectoryLines left metadata unescaped); and WikiBrowser lacked knowledgeBaseId reload and post-unmount statsTimer guards.
findings.regression_test: WikiBrowser enforces canEdit on folder/drag/issue controls, escapes wiki link/index markdown, and resets/stops timers across KB switch and unmount

findings.summary: Expanding a partial sync log with error_message: null crashed with TypeError on log.error_message.slice(0, 1000), and switching dataSourceId while open did not reload sync logs.
findings.regression_test: DataSourceSyncLogs handles null error_message on partial syncs without crashing and reloads when dataSourceId changes

findings.summary: Unsaved paused tempDsId drafts leaked on component unmount or Step 0 connector switches, and modifying credentials after tempDsId creation in create mode failed to sync credentials via putDataSourceCredentials before re-listing resources.
findings.regression_test: DataSourceEditorDialog cleans up unsaved tempDsId on unmount or type switch and syncs replaced credentials before temp resource listing

findings.summary: Added stale-response sequence/unmount/KB-switch guards across activity, data source, wiki revision, share, chunking debug, KB list, upload dialog, and gallery components, cleared ImageGallery prefsTimer on unmount, and enforced http(s): scheme validation in KbUploadSourceDropdown.
findings.regression_test: KnowledgeBaseActivitySettings, DataSourceSettings, WikiRevisionDrawer, KBShareSettings, KBChunkingDebug, KnowledgeBaseList, KbUploadSourceDropdown, UploadConfirmDialog, ImageGallery, and GallerySourcePicker guard stale async state and schemes

invariants_checked: Toolbox refreshes summary skill/MCP badge counts and re-keys child panels on active workspace (effectiveTenantId) or user switches while ignoring stale responses from earlier epochs or after unmount.

findings.summary: Summary count badges (counts.skills, counts.mcp) and child panels were not refreshed or re-keyed on active workspace/user switches and lacked epoch/unmount fencing against late responses.
findings.regression_test: Toolbox refreshes summary badges on workspace switch and ignores late responses after unmount
